constraints: numbers is sorted in non-decreasing order
hints: The hash-map Two Sum works but uses O(n) space. What does sortedness buy you?
Look at the smallest + largest. If the sum is too big, can the largest value be part of the answer at all?
Pointers at both ends: too small → move l right, too big → move r left.

insight.mnemonic: Too small, step right; too big, step left.
insight.oneLiner: Sum too small → move the left pointer up; too big → move the right pointer down. Sortedness makes each move safe.
insight.pattern: Converging two pointers on sorted input

recall.a: Every other partner for numbers[l] is ≤ numbers[r], so every sum with it is also too small.
recall.q: Why can l be discarded when the sum is too small?

insight.why: When numbers[l] + numbers[r] < target, numbers[l] can't pair with anything ≤ numbers[r], so l can be discarded. Each step discards one index: O(n) total.

oneLiner: Sum too small → move the left pointer up; too big → move the right pointer down. Sortedness makes each move safe.

pitfalls.explain: This problem wants 1-indexed positions: add 1 to both.
pitfalls.title: Returned 0-indexed positions

pitfalls.explain: Stop when l == r: the two positions must differ.
pitfalls.title: Used one element twice

solutions.idea: For each element, binary-search for its complement in the sorted suffix.
solutions.name: Binary search the complement

footnotes.text: Because the array is sorted, one comparison rules out a whole set of pairs: if numbers[l] + numbers[r] is too small, numbers[l] is too small with every partner left of r as well.

solutions.idea: Start at both ends; move the pointer that brings the sum toward the target.
solutions.name: Two pointers

starter:
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, numbers: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
statement:
`numbers` is sorted in non-decreasing order. Find the two different positions whose values add up to `target`, and return them as `[index1, index2]` with **1-indexed** positions and `index1 < index2`.

There is exactly one solution. Use only O(1) extra space.
title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
